annotations.title: Replay past decisions under new rules

description: Forensic Replay Sandbox. Replays every AI decision sealed with the customer's API key under a new rule set and returns which verdicts would change, which way, by month, the money behind them and the rule that caused each. Rule set: allow_below and block_from (verdict boundaries, today 0.35 and 0.70), factors (history, amount, device_risk, anomaly, unsafe_country as multipliers, 1 = unchanged), high_risk_countries and safe_countries (country codes), signal_weights for the customer's own risk signals, and rules: [{name, field, op (eq, ne, gt, gte, lt, lte, in, not_in, contains, exists), value, then (CHALLENGE or BLOCK)}] on any field they send. Records are verified untouched first and only exactly reproducible decisions are counted. The run is sealed into the chain and gets a shareable report link.
